messages:
Maya (Product): Quick follow-up on the on-prem setup wizard UX. Noticed issues with host rows on small screens and a11y announcements. Screenshot: https://redwood.design/s/onprem-compact
Rina (Design): On mobile the three-column layout collapses badly. Suggest a compact list: icon + short label + chevron to expand details. Keeps actions visible.
Sam (Engineering): Agree. Implementation: make each row a single flex line with .detail { min-width: 0 } so text truncates instead of wrapping. I'll add a CSS class.
Jordan (Accessibility): Row must be focusable (tabindex=0) and toggled with Enter/Space. Use aria-expanded on the toggle and aria-controls on the detail panel. Announce expansions with role="region" and aria-labelledby.
Priya (PM): Copy tweaks: change terse errors to action-first lines. Example: instead of 'Port 22 fail' use 'SSH (port 22) blocked 00 Check security group or host firewall.' Short CTA: 'Fix connection'.
Rina (Design): Also status chips in dark theme blend into background. Add a 1px outline and increase text weight. I'll pick tokens that meet 4.5:1 contrast.
Sam (Engineering): For probe updates, they flicker when many quick changes happen. We'll debounce client updates (250ms) and send final states to the aria-live region.
Jordan (Accessibility): Use aria-live="polite" on the progress summary. Do not move focus unless user expands a row. When a row expands, focus the first interactive element in the panel.
Maya (Product): Edge case: skipped checks for air-gapped installs should show 'Network checks skipped by policy' with a tooltip explaining why.
Priya (PM): Acceptance criteria I'll add: compact host list at <=480px, truncated names with expand, collapsed logs by default, aria-live for summaries, keyboard-expand with aria-expanded, chip colors AA/contrast in both themes.
deploy-bot: Reminder: design review in 45m in #product. Bring mobile screens :mega:
Rina (Design): I'll upload two Figma variants (inline collapsed logs vs flyout) and updated chip tokens. Posting link here when ready.
Sam (Engineering): I'll add a small e2e check for aria-expanded and the live region message 'All probes complete' before shipping the client patch.
Maya (Product): Thanks team. Post Figma + test build here and I'll update the ticket acceptance criteria.
